description: This file defines the class RegexChannelNamespacePredicate, which implements IChannelNamespacePredicate to filter stream namespaces using regular expressions. It provides pattern matching capabilities for stream namespace filtering within the Orleans.BroadcastChannel namespace.

classes.name: RegexChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Implements namespace filtering based on regular expressions. Provides methods to instantiate with a regex pattern and to check if a stream namespace matches the pattern.

methods.name: RegexChannelNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that compiles the provided regex pattern for use in namespace matching.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property that returns the regex pattern string used for filtering.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Method that determines if a given stream namespace matches the regex pattern.
